Get the Population by Municipality, Sex and Age

Source: R/pop-gemeinde.R
popGemeinde.Rd

Returns the permanent (or non-permanent) resident population on 31 December by municipality, sex and single year of age, from the BFS population statistics STATPOP. It is the standard denominator for rates per municipality and the basis for age-standardisation.

Usage

popGemeinde(
  year = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  population = c("permanent", "non-permanent"),
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

year

vector of statistical years (whole numbers). The default NULL uses the most recent year available.

id

optional vector of BFS municipality numbers (whole numbers) to keep; NULL returns all municipalities.

population

population type, "permanent" (ständige Wohnbevölkerung) or "non-permanent" (nichtständige Wohnbevölkerung).

cache

logical; if TRUE, results are read from and written to the local cache (see cacheList()).

refresh

logical; if TRUE, the source is queried again even if a cached copy exists.

Value

A data.frame with the columns jahr_n, gem_stand_d, gem_id, sex_c ("m", "w"), age_n, age_open_l and ch_n (number of persons). The key is jahr_n + gem_stand_d + gem_id + sex_c + age_n.

Details

The data come from the BFS PXWeb cube px-x-0102010000_101. All selections are made through the cube metadata: variables are found by name, municipalities by their level marker in the value labels (not by position), the requested years are validated against the available ones and sex is mapped explicitly (1 = "m", 2 = "w"). The open top age class ("100 Jahre und mehr") is kept as age_n = 100 and flagged with age_open_l = TRUE; it must not be read as the exact age 100.

Spatial reference. The reference date of the counts (31 December, jahr_n) and the municipality stand of the cube are two different things. The BFS publishes the whole time series on one municipality stand (e.g. "Raumbezug: Gemeinden / 06.04.2025"), not on the stand of the respective year. That stand is read from the table page and returned in gem_stand_d; join geometries and registers of that stand, e.g. geoGemeinde(unique(pop$gem_stand_d)). If the page cannot be read, gem_stand_d is NA and a warning is given. An unchanged BFS number does not guarantee unchanged boundaries, so always join on the stand, not on the year.

Large requests are split automatically to respect the cell limit of the API. Each year is cached for the whole of Switzerland and per spatial reference; id only filters the result. Cells the source marks as unavailable are NA. sourceInfo() keeps the POST selections and the time of the original download of each year.

See also

gemeinde(), geoGemeinde().

Other swiss.statistics: arealGemeinde(), noas()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pop <- popGemeinde(year = 2021)
unique(pop$gem_stand_d)               # spatial reference of the cube
popTotal <- aggregate(ch_n ~ gem_id, data = pop, FUN = sum)
geo <- geoGemeinde(unique(pop$gem_stand_d))
} # }
